summary.text: Shery Olivo is the Conservative Party nominee for NY Assembly District 86, after losing the Republican primary to Maria Diaz. Describes herself as a Dominican-American community advocate, author, wife and mother, and an entrepreneur born in the Dominican Republic and raised in the Bronx. She is running on public safety, education and cost-of-living themes.

paragraphs.text: Born in the Dominican Republic and raised in the Bronx, according to her campaign website.
Earned a high school diploma from Morris High School and an associate degree from Monroe College in 2010.
Career experience includes working as an entrepreneur.

Describes herself in her Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey as a Dominican-American community advocate, author, wife and mother; her campaign website describes her as a wife, mother of two and entrepreneur.
Says her decision to run was driven in part by the death of her nephew, Juan Peña.
Advanced unopposed on the Conservative Party line for the November 2026 general election after losing the June 23, 2026 Republican primary to Maria Diaz.
